extracted.intended_audience: academic researchers (faculty, PhD students, postdocs), research collaborators, and institutions interested in Microsoft Research programs
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of Microsoft Research academic programs, fellowships, collaborations, events, and resources intended to support and partner with academic researchers across disciplines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Microsoft Research Fellowship
rubrics_metrics.description: The Microsoft Research Fellowship creates opportunities for academic scholars (faculty, PhD students, and postdocs) to collaborate with Microsoft Research on open research challenges that advance scientific understanding, drive innovation, and deliver societal benefit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program aimed at enabling collaboration on open research challenges; positions eligible scholars (faculty, PhD students, postdocs) to work with MSR to advance science, innovation, and societal impact. (Page links to 'Learn about the program' for details.)

rubrics_metrics.name: AI & Society Fellows
rubrics_metrics.description: Aims to catalyze research collaboration between Microsoft Research and eminent scholars and experts across a range of disciplines core to discussions at the intersection of AI and its impact on society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes interdisciplinary scholarship focused on societal impacts of AI and collaboration between MSR and leading external experts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accelerating Foundation Models Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Through this program, we hope to re-imagine AI learning and research using foundation models, while also exploring new use cases that can complement human ingenuity through diversified research expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on foundation models: rethinking AI learning/research and exploring complementary human-centric use cases; encourages diversified research expertise and new directions enabled by foundation models.

rubrics_metrics.name: The New Future of Work
rubrics_metrics.description: This cross-company initiative is dedicated to creating solutions for a future of work that is meaningful, productive, and equitable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Centers on the evolving nature of work (shift from remote to hybrid) and the role of AI in changing work practices; intended as collaborative, cross-company research and solutions work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Events and conferences as engagement opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Events and conferences provide opportunities to meet our community of researchers, learn about exciting research topics, and grow your network.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use events and conferences to connect with MSR researchers, discover research topics, and expand academic networks; presented as opportunities to engage rather than formal application programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic fellowships, grants, and competitions — diversity and pipeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Microsoft recognizes the value of diversity in computing and aims to increase the pipeline of talent receiving advanced degrees in computing-related fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs in this category are designed to increase diversity in computing and expand the pipeline of graduate-level talent via fellowships, grants, and competitions; intended audience includes students and early-career scholars.

rubrics_metrics.name: Careers in research
rubrics_metrics.description: Join a brilliant team of researchers working to solve technology’s most exciting challenges. Come as you are. Do what you love. Opportunities abound.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communicates recruiting posture and encouragement for prospective research hires; points to 'View open roles' for specific positions and hiring criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research tools (code, datasets, models, SDKs, APIs)
rubrics_metrics.description: We maintain an index of datasets, models, SDKs, APIs, and other open-source code created by Microsoft researchers and shared with the broader academic community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MSR curates and shares research artifacts to support reproducibility and collaboration; intended as resources for academics to use and build upon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Featured research collaborations — global engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Microsoft collaborates with the global research community through programs, events, learning opportunities, and joint research endeavors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights MSR's collaborative initiatives and encourages participation via programs and joint projects; serves as an umbrella for specific collaboration efforts described on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI, Cognition, and the Economy (AICE)
rubrics_metrics.description: AICE establishes a global research network dedicated to cultivating an interdisciplinary research community. This collective will delve into the profound impact of Generative AI (GAI) on human cognition, work dynamics, and economic growth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targets interdisciplinary research into GAI’s effects on cognition, labor, and the economy; framed as a global network for collaborative projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Center for Societal impact through Cloud and Artificial Intelligence (SCAI)
rubrics_metrics.description: MSR India's Center for Societal impact through Cloud and Artificial Intelligence (SCAI) focuses on creating, nurturing and deploying technologies that will have large scale impact on society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmatic focus on development and deployment of cloud/AI technologies with large-scale societal impact; emphasizes creation, nurturing, and deployment in an Indian MSR context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Microsoft Climate Research Initiative (MCRI)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Microsoft Climate Research Initiative (MCRI) is a community of multi-disciplinary researchers working together to fight climate change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convenes multidisciplinary researchers for climate-related research; positions the initiative as a community for collaborative climate science efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plural Technology Collaboratory
rubrics_metrics.description: The Plural Technology Collaboratory is a Microsoft Research Special Project dedicated to advancing Plural Technologies (PTs), ones that support diverse communities and empower collaboration across them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on technologies that support diverse communities and cross-community collaboration, motivated by advances in digital technologies (especially generative models); emphasizes inclusivity and collaboration in technology design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Studies in Pandemic Preparedness
rubrics_metrics.description: These collaborative projects with academia span topics including infection prevention and control, treatment and diagnostics, allocation of resources, mental health implications and return to work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports multidisciplinary collaborations addressing pandemic preparedness and response across public health, diagnostics, resource allocation, and mental health; framed as joint projects with academic partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Microsoft Research Forum (event series)
rubrics_metrics.description: Join us for a continuous exchange of ideas about research in the era of general AI. Watch the first six Episodes on-demand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An event/series format to foster ongoing discussion on AI-era research topics; useful for engagement, knowledge-sharing, and community building.
